name: Des Plaines (United States)
description: White field with a green stripe along the bottom bearing the name DES PLAINES in white, charged at the centre with the city emblem — an eagle over a map of Illinois within a yellow ring reading DIGNITY, DETERMINATION and DECENCY, the date 1835 split by the emblem — and a yellow star in each upper corner.
history: Des Plaines is a city in Cook County, Illinois. The flag was adopted on 27 August 1960, according to English Wikipedia.

features.role: city emblem with an eagle and the date 1835
